selected_candidate.name: prefill_cuda_graph_excess_padding_guard
selected_candidate.reason: Unlike the other two candidates, the guard is model-independent and could in principle touch the exact 4,214-token prompt path. Its first decision-bearing consumer is PrefillCudaGraphRunner.can_run_graph; the focused falsifier is whether the locked v0.5.13 runtime and exact launch can enter that consumer.

rejected_before_implementation.name: trait_driven_per_token_group_quant
rejected_before_implementation.reason: The upstream call-site explicitly routes whole-row group quant to the existing sglang_per_token_quant_fp8 kernel. Gemma 4's dense dynamic-FP8 activation path is whole-row, so the new grouped kernel is not its producer.

rejected_before_implementation.name: hpc_ops_attention_backend
rejected_before_implementation.reason: The backend requires head_dim 128 and rejects sliding-window layers. Exact Gemma 4 uses d256 local, d512 global, 50 sliding-window layers, and 10 full-attention layers.

implementation_boundary.producer: The current-runtime prefill runner derives raw num_tokens from len(forward_batch.input_ids) and pads it to the next configured capture bucket.
implementation_boundary.decision_bearing_consumer: PrefillCudaGraphRunner.can_run_graph compares padded_num_tokens with two times raw num_tokens and selects graph replay or eager forward.
implementation_boundary.falsifier: If the locked SGLang v0.5.13 tree lacks the prefill graph runner/config or the exact launch cannot enable a prefill capture, the selected mechanism removes zero exact-workload work and the project returns typed none.
